case_number: 2024 INSC 479; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (Arising out of S.L.P. (Crl.) No. 6339-6340 of 2023)
summary: Bail conditions for foreigner under NDPS Act; certificate-of-assurance requirement from foreign embassy questioned; location tracking via Google Maps challenged; bail conditions must align with CrPC s.437(3); 'interest of justice' standard must avoid arbitrary/freakish conditions; no broader interpretation of permissible conditions.
legal_provisions_cited: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.8, s.22, s.23, s.29, s.37
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.437(3), s.438(2)(iv), s.439
Kunal Kumar Tiwari v. State of Bihar
Munish Bhasin v. State (NCT of Delhi)
Supreme Court Legal Aid Committee v. Union of India
final_judgment: Leave granted; issues referred for reconsideration regarding bail conditions for foreign nationals; amicus curiae requested to assist.
